name: Cyber Destroyer
effect: HIT: You may keep one of your Continuous Boosts in play at the end of this Strike (any cumulative bonuses on those Boosts reset).

name: Upgrade

boost.name: Mandatory Upgrades
effect: At the start of each of the opponent's turns, +1 Power (max of +3).
BEFORE: Do not discard any of your Continuous Boosts in play at the end of this Strike (any cumulative bonuses on these Boosts reset).

name: Riot Machine

boost.name: Revoke
effect: Choose a Continuous Boost in play. It now affects you instead of its controller.
BEFORE: +2 Power for each Continuous Boost you have in play.

boost.name: Auto-Defense Engine
effect: At the start of each of the opponent's turns, +1 Armor (max of +3).

boost.name: Lost Memories
effect: At the start of each of the opponent's turns, +1 Speed (max of +3).

name: Shifting Technology

boost.name: Liberation
effect: At the start of each of the opponent's turns, add the top card of your Discard to your Gauge.
HIT: Do not discard your Continuous Boosts at the end of this Strike (any cumulative bonuses on those Boosts reset).

name: Harnessing Chaos

boost.name: Rejuvenation
effect: At the start of each of the opponent's turns, draw a card.
BEFORE: For each Continuous Boost you have in play, +1 Power and +0-1 Range.
